Overview

Landline Number, explained

Traditional phone lines are expensive, tied to one building and slow to change. Cloud phone systems give you a landline number that works anywhere.

Your local number rings desk phones, computers and mobile apps, with extensions, transfers and voicemail to email. Adding or moving staff takes minutes, not technician visits.

Who it's for

  • Offices replacing old phone systems
  • Teams working from home and the office
  • Businesses opening new locations
  • Businesses wanting one phone system for everyone

Why it matters

Why Landline Number matters for your business

Traditional phone lines tie your number to one place and cost more to maintain. Cloud phone systems give you a landline number that works anywhere.

Staff can answer on desk phones, computers or mobiles, so calls aren't missed when people are away from their desks.

Adding users, moving offices or changing call flows takes minutes, without technician visits.

Pricing

What affects the cost of Landline Number

  • How many numbers and users you need
  • Whether you're keeping existing numbers or getting new ones
  • Call flow complexity, such as menus, queues and after-hours rules
  • Handsets, if you want desk phones
  • For customer care: the hours, channels and call volumes to cover

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

FAQ

Landline Number questions

Can we keep our current number?

In most cases, yes. We handle the transfer.

Do we need new handsets?

Not necessarily. Softphone and mobile apps work too.

What happens if the internet goes down?

Calls can divert to mobiles automatically, so you don't miss customers.

Is call quality good?

Yes, with a reliable internet connection. We'll check your setup first.

Do we need new desk phones?

Not necessarily. Softphone and mobile apps work too, and we can supply compatible handsets.

Can we have extensions?

Yes, with transfers and hunt groups.

Can we see call history?

Yes, with call logs and reports.
